questions.question: How many automorphisms does the $4 \times 4$ tic-tac-toe hypergraph ($16$ cells, $10$ lines) have?
questions.explanation: It has $32$ automorphisms—four times its $8$ geometric symmetries—because inner row/column swaps like $(2\;3)$ preserve rows, columns, and both diagonals.

questions.question: What is the order of the automorphism group of the Fano plane ($7$ points, $7$ three-point lines)?
questions.explanation: Choose the images of $3$ non-collinear points in $7 \cdot 6 \cdot 4 = 168$ ways; those $3$ base points determine the images of all $7$ points uniquely.

questions.question: How many distinct bracelets (rotations and reflections allowed) have $6$ beads in $2$ colors?
questions.explanation: Rotations fix $84$ colorings ($14$ necklaces), and the $6$ reflections fix $3 \cdot 2^4 + 3 \cdot 2^3 = 72$, giving $(84 + 72)/12 = 13$ bracelets.

questions.question: Using the cube face formula $(k^6 + 3k^4 + 12k^3 + 8k^2)/24$, how many essentially different ways can you paint the $6$ faces of a cube using $2$ colors?
